subject: Instruction mining from Intel OMF
summary: Never search raw OMF bytes for opcode evidence. Parse LNAMES and SEGDEF first and decode only LEDATA whose segment class is CODE; otherwise comments strings DATA and other non-code payloads can create false x86 instruction hits.

subject: snd_load 89 C3 clean-code corpus survey
